# Glossary and Terminology

Short definitions for terms used across the tutorial. Expand as chapters land.

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **body / link** | Rigid piece with mass and pose; URDF *link*, MJCF *body*. |
| **joint** | Model object connecting bodies (hinge, slide, ball, …); not the same as DoF count. |
| **DoF** | One scalar degree of freedom in `q` / `qvel` / `dq`; see [Joint vs DoF](robotics-basics/rotations-and-frames.qmd#joint-vs-dof). |
| **nq / nv / nu** | MuJoCo: `qpos` length, velocity DoFs, actuator count — often equal on fixed arms, diverge with quaternions or under-actuation. |
| **geom** | Collision and/or visual shape attached to a body; not a degree of freedom. |
| **visual geom** | Mesh or primitive used only for rendering. |
| **collision geom** | Shape used for contact and constraints; often simpler than the visual. |
| **compound geom** | Several collision shapes on one link (capsules + boxes, multiple hulls). |
| **convex hull** | Smallest convex set containing a point set / mesh; simulators use hulls for fast contact. |
| **convex decomposition** | Represent a non-convex mesh as a union of convex pieces (often via Qhull on clusters; VHACD/CoACD in production). |
| **soft contact** | Compliant contact: small penetration, spring–damper forces (MuJoCo; default Motrix on standard MJCF). |
| **hard contact** | Non-penetrating contact impulses (PhysX / Isaac default; Motrix optional via `_hard` geoms). |
| **watertight mesh** | Closed mesh with well-defined volume (every edge shared by two faces). |
| **point cloud** | Unordered set of 3D samples (depth/LiDAR); no connectivity. |
| **voxel grid** | Regular 3D lattice of cells (occupancy, TSDF, density, labels). |
| **occupancy grid** | Voxel grid whose payload is free/occupied (binary or probabilistic). |
| **TSDF** | Truncated signed distance field stored on a voxel grid (common in RGB-D fusion). |
| **SDF** | Signed distance function — implicit field; usually $|f|=$ distance, sign = inside/outside. |
| **marching cubes** | Extract a triangle mesh as the zero level set of a scalar grid. |
| **contype / conaffinity** | MuJoCo bitmasks controlling which geoms collide with which. |
| **from_geom** | MuJoCo option to infer mass/inertia from geom density and shape. |
| **FK / IK** | Forward / inverse kinematics — joint coordinates ↔ poses. |
| **servo / servoing** | **Closed-loop** control that drives a joint (or tool) toward a **setpoint** — position, velocity, or both — by reading state and writing forces or targets each tick. *Servoing* is running that loop continuously. A **position actuator** (`ctrl = q*`) embeds a PD servo in the simulator ([Joint PD](robotics-basics/state-sensors-and-actuators.qmd#joint-pd-control)); a **motor actuator** (`ctrl = τ`) expects **you** to implement the servo in code ([Position vs motor](robotics-basics/simulation-stability.qmd#position-vs-motor-actuators)). Distinct from a hardware *servo motor* (motor + gearbox + encoder), though the control problem is the same. |
| **IPC** | Inter-process communication — shared memory, ZMQ, LCM; see [Advanced — IPC](advanced/inter-process-communication.qmd#inter-process-communication). |
| **PPO** | Proximal Policy Optimization — on-policy policy-gradient update with a clipped importance ratio. Diagnostics: [PPO diagnostics](reinforcement-learning/ppo-diagnostics.qmd#ppo-diagnostics-and-training-dynamics). |
| **advantage** | How much better an action was than the critic's baseline, here from GAE. Standardized to mean $0$ and std $1$ before the policy loss. |
| **GAE** | Generalized Advantage Estimation — $\lambda$-return residual used as $\hat A$, with $R = \hat A + V$. |
| **importance ratio** | $r = \pi_\theta(a\mid s) / \pi_{\theta_{\mathrm{old}}}(a\mid s)$. Equals $1$ on the rollout that collected the data. |
| **explained variance** | $1 - \mathrm{MSE}(V, R) / \mathrm{Var}(R)$. Scale-free reading of the value fit; the raw value loss is not. |
| **approximate KL** | Schulman's nonnegative estimate $\mathrm{mean}((r-1)-\log r)$, in nats, of how far the current policy has moved from the rollout policy. |
| **policy entropy** | For a diagonal Gaussian, $\sum_i \log\sigma_i + \tfrac{d}{2}\log(2\pi e)$. Depends on the action scale only. State-independent $\sigma$ is one learned vector; state-dependent $\sigma(s)$ is a head. See [Entropy dynamics](reinforcement-learning/ppo-diagnostics.qmd#entropy-dynamics). |
| **site** | Named frame on a body (EE, sensor origin); no mass. |

See also [References and external docs](references.qmd#references), [PPO diagnostics](reinforcement-learning/ppo-diagnostics.qmd#ppo-diagnostics-and-training-dynamics), [Geometry and collision](robotics-basics/geometry-and-collision.qmd#geometry-and-collision) (sim assets), and [Geometric computing](advanced/geometric-computing.qmd#geometric-computing) (Stanford bunny / clouds / voxels / SDFs / rays). Process env vars: [Common environment variables](environment-variables.qmd#common-environment-variables).
